title: Grok Bot parity tests and doctor diagnostics
description: Done when: parity tests pass on fixtures and doctor reports the persistence dir.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Parity covered by 5 lib unit tests (discovery + roster + cloud stubs, seq ordering, persona author + raw voice call + unknown-type skip counting, capped partial flag, doctor flags unreadable blobs) plus 6 executable BDD scenarios (wip tag dropped; the capped-view Then step reworded to 'the extracted session is flagged as a partial local view' because the R12 partial-session step already owns the original wording for fixture sessions). Full gate green.

right_now_summary: Parity tests and doctor diagnostics are awaiting fixture checks and persistence-directory reporting.
